content.title: Add a configured product with a valid non-1 quantity and see the cart update correctly
content.intent: Prove that a shopper can add a valid product after selecting required options, receive a success confirmation, see the header cart signals update, and have the entered non-1 quantity carry into the cart exactly.
content.technique_notes: Derived from happy-path reading of retail-storefront REQ-03 with techniques: eqp for a valid configured product and a valid non-1 quantity representative; state_flow not applicable because the source does not define a gated multi-step wizard; bva considered but not applied because the source gives no quantity bounds and the owner chose valid-quantity coverage only for now; risk-judged strength=3 because money applies, but no combinatorial expansion was needed because the path has one outcome-bearing representative combination.
